item.name: Sheckles
item.obtainment: Sell crops and pets for Sheckles. Players can also earn Sheckles through pets such as the Tanuki, Pancake Mole,Crab, and Mole. NPCs also reward players Sheckles for completing a quest. Players could also get Sheckles through the Forever Pack or, when it existed, by buying them directly with Robux in the Limited Time Shop. Other players can also gift Sheckles.

item.name: Garden Coins
item.obtainment: Exchange 1 trillion sheckles for 10 garden coins to Orson the Coin Keeper at the corner of the map. Sheckles will increase as players exchange more.

item.name: Pass Points
item.obtainment: Earned by completing Season Pass tasks. They can also be purchased directly with Robux.

item.name: Trade Token
item.obtainment: Obtain by either buying with Robux in the game shop or by players purchasing their items in the Trade World.

item.name: Honey
item.obtainment: Give pollinated fruits to Onett, the honey merchant.

item.name: Lunar Points
item.obtainment: Exchange moonlit crops for Lunar Points during the Lunar Glow Event, which allowed players to access certain items.

item.name: Summer Coin
item.obtainment: Once every 1,000 points earned in the Summer Harvest Event will convert to 1 Summer Coin.

item.name: Chi
item.obtainment: Exchange tranquil crops for Chi at the Tanuki NPC and give tranquil crops to the Zen Channeller until the bar is full during the Zen Event.

item.name: Fairy Point
item.obtainment: Submit glimmering fruits to the wishing well or interact with fairies around the map during the Fairy Event.

item.name: Candy Corn
item.obtainment: Submit fruits to the Witch Cauldron, the Jack O Lantern NPC and the Harvest Reaper.

item.name: Carrot Coins
item.obtainment: Complete one of the Garden Games Quests from Greg during the Garden Games Event.

item.name: Buttercup Coins
item.obtainment: Complete one of the Buttercup Quests from Brooklyn during the Buttercup Quest Event.

item.name: Heart Coins
item.obtainment: Exchange heartstruck, cute or heartbound fruits for Heart Coins to Heather during the Valentine's Event
